name: pumpdata
description: Before an alpha call or a buy on pump.fun: the base rate for the band (how often coins like this one paid), what the buyers have been, the deployer's record (from a mint, or from the dev wallet before a coin exists), the similar launches by name, and an honest replay of a pick list with fees and fills, from every pump.fun trade ever. Yesterday's base rates free; the rest paid per call in USDC over x402, no key, no account.
author: pumpdatafun
